name: SendGrid
description: Typed bounded SendGrid mail, scheduled batches, templates, contacts, lists, segments, suppressions, verified senders, statistics and address validation.

permissions.description: Fixed official SendGrid v3 global/EU HTTPS endpoints with externally supplied restricted API keys. Explicit confirmation for mutations and paid validation; no retries, auto pagination, webhooks, remote attachments or inbox access.

definitions.name: SendGrid Send Mail
definitions.description: SendGrid Send Mail
definitions.documentation: SendGrid Send Mail: one POST /v3/mail/send. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID MAIL-SEND. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid Rename Template
definitions.description: SendGrid Rename Template
definitions.documentation: SendGrid Rename Template: one PATCH /v3/templates/{template_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID TEMPLATES-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Create Contact List
definitions.documentation: SendGrid Create Contact List: one POST /v3/marketing/lists. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation: SendGrid Remove Contacts from List: one DELETE /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}/contacts. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-REMOVE-CONTACTS. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation: SendGrid Create Segment V2: one POST /v3/marketing/segments/2.0. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SEGMENTS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. definitions.name: SendGrid Add Group Suppressions
definitions.description: SendGrid Add Group Suppressions
definitions.documentation: SendGrid Add Group Suppressions: one POST /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}/suppressions. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GROUP-SUPPRESSIONS-ADD. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs.
